answer: You don't need a payoff letter, because Lakeshore Bank is in our e-payoff network. We confirm the payoff directly with them the same day at your appointment, using your loan account number. You pay the roughly $1,000 difference at the appointment by cashier's check or debit card. We don't accept personal checks or credit cards, and if you'd rather not pay the difference, you can keep the car, since an offer never obliges you to sell.
